run_aloi_handler: run the aloi_handler function on a dataset path to get metadata and split generators
run_aloi_handler_grey: run the aloi_handler function with is_grey true to process grayscale ALOI images
use_aloi_dataset: use the aloi_dataset DownloadableDataset object to download and process RGB ALOI tar archives
use_aloi_grey_dataset: use the aloi_grey_dataset DownloadableDataset object to download and process grayscale ALOI tar archives
review_aloi_handler: review the aloi_handler function to understand how it splits training and test categories
